'''Clan Sharratt''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan existing around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, Clan Sharratt was testing a new Imperial combat adrenal and issued a challenge for the Republic defenders: come face them in combat, or the Mandalorians would begin destroying random Republic property on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, they were defeated in their their [[Clan Sharratt enclave|enclave]], their banners were burnt, and their leader [[Kassor Quade]] was killed.<ref name="TOR:MR" />

During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.2}}</ref> the Clan would become supporters of the [[Hidden Chain]], a splinter faction formed by [[Heta Kol]].<ref name="Nowhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Sharratt and its chieftain are the main antagonists of the mission [HEROIC 2+] "Mandalorian Rage," only playable for Republic factions in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:MR" />
